title: openai-responses-compat: support response variants, seed passthrough, and determinism flags
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds OpenAI Responses API variants compatibility: passthrough for seed and deterministic flags, metadata passthrough into response objects and telemetry. Updates streaming and function-calling mappings. No breaking changes; defaults preserved.
description: Summary: This PR extends the OpenAI-compatibility layer to support the newer Responses API variants and associated features we need for parity (seed/determinism flags and arbitrary metadata passthrough). Motivation: several customers and SDK examples rely on the Responses surface; to avoid surprise behavioral differences we must propagate seed and determinism parameters from the OpenAI-compatible request into the runtime and ensure metadata attached by callers is returned untouched and logged in telemetry. Changes include: - request parsing and validation for Responses-style payloads (response_format variants) - passthrough of `seed` and `deterministic` flags into the serving runtime and the model execution layer - preservation of top-level `metadata` in generated responses and in internal event payloads (audit/logging/trace) - streaming compatibility fixes for the responses wire protocol (ensure consistent event types for token/choice/tool-calls) - function/tool-calling mapping adjustments to match OpenAI Responses semantics - tests: unit + integration + SDK mapping tests - docs: short compat section in openai-compat guide Checklist: - [x] Add request parsing and validation - [x] Wire seed/deterministic flags through to runtime - [x] Preserve metadata and include in telemetry - [x] Update streaming/event mapping and SDK compatibility tests - [x] Add unit & e2e tests - [x] Update docs and release notes Related: ENG-3412 (Responses compatibility), ENG-3420 (determinism/seed telemetry)

review_comments: Liam: Can we avoid turning on deterministic by default? We should preserve current defaults. — addressed, added explicit preservation and tests.
Maya: Make sure metadata size is limited before attaching to telemetry (PII risk). — added truncation + warning in telemetry pipeline.
Ethan: Streaming event mapping looks complex; add unit tests for token/choice/tool ordering. — added tests and e2e that assert ordering under simulated backpressure.
Liam: CI flaked on e2e once, reran and green. Approved for merge.
Maya: small nits in docs, pushed follow-up commit to docs. Approved.

conversation_summary: Tight review focused on preserving existing defaults (no implicit deterministic behavior), metadata PII safeguards, and ensuring streaming event semantics align with OpenAI Responses. Small documentation nits were fixed. CI required a rerun for a flaky e2e but passed. Approved by reviewers and merged via squash.
notes_for_release: Document the new OpenAI Responses compatibility behavior: callers can now pass `seed` and `deterministic` (boolean) which will be forwarded to the runtime. `metadata` fields are echoed in the response object and emitted to telemetry (truncated/filtered to avoid PII). Streaming event types updated to better match OpenAI Responses semantics; SDK mappings updated — verify SDK versions after release.
